mapper.insert: insert into company_review( review_id, company_id, communication_rate, price_rate, result_rate, schedule_rate, structure_type, area_pyeong, construction_field) values ( #{reviewId}, #{companyId}, #{communicationRate}, #{priceRate}, #{resultRate}, #{scheduleRate}, #{structureType}, #{areaPyeong}, #{constructionField} )

insert into company_score_avg( company_id, company_review_count, sum_communication, sum_price, sum_result, sum_schedule, avg_communication, avg_price, avg_result, avg_schedule, avg_total_rate) values ( #{companyId}, 1, #{communicationRate}, #{priceRate}, #{resultRate}, #{scheduleRate}, #{communicationRate}, #{priceRate}, #{resultRate}, #{scheduleRate}, (#{communicationRate} + #{priceRate} + #{resultRate} + #{scheduleRate} ) / 4.0 )
mapper.update:
update company_score_avg set company_review_count = company_review_count + 1,
sum_communication = sum_communication + #{communicationRate}, sum_price = sum_price + #{priceRate}, sum_result = sum_result + #{resultRate}, sum_schedule = sum_schedule + #{scheduleRate},
avg_communication = (sum_communication + #{communicationRate}) / (company_review_count + 1), avg_price = (sum_price + #{priceRate}) / (company_review_count + 1), avg_result = (sum_result + #{resultRate}) / (company_review_count + 1), avg_schedule = (sum_schedule + #{scheduleRate}) / (company_review_count + 1),
avg_total_rate = ( (sum_communication + #{communicationRate}) + (sum_price + #{priceRate}) + (sum_result + #{resultRate}) + (sum_schedule + #{scheduleRate}) ) / 4 / (company_review_count + 1) where company_id = #{companyId}
